[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Place past Pomodoros on today's timeline with the x= segment suffix[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`x=E[~|~n|~n+|~~][!][=X]` records past work against an edge of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]today's timeline (the tail since the last closed Pomodoro, a closed[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pomodoro, a gap, or the head before the first row). Placement is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exact and guarded, every cut is reported, and a plain `x=` stays [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]byte-for-byte unchanged. bob ships a segment picker, a typed `-` to[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]suffix, the picker, and a card that names the segment.[/#D7D7AF]
